title: AgentDurableGoal
description: Cross-session durable goal driving every oyatie agent action across the hyperscaler product/service lifecycle (planning, development, CI/CD, deployment). Companion to agent_operating_contract (per-session checklist) — this is the persistent ambition + non-negotiable guardrails. Read at session start; verified against on every state-changing action.

changelog.change: initial draft — identity + persistent_goal + lifecycle (4 phases) + 10 operating_principles + confusion_management + verification_before_completion + scope_discipline + pattern_to_follow + stop_conditions + memory_pointers
sharpened: lifecycle phases now carry entry_gate + exit_gate + back_edges; added iteration_loops; added spec_contract; added tdd_contract; added pipeline

100% AUTONOMOUS FOUNDRY: added autonomous_foundry; REMOVED human-escalation paths. Per user directive 2026-05-16: target autonomy = 100%, quorum = 2 distinct vendors CC-1/CC-2 + 1 CC-3, lane promotion drift → ≥3 prevented incidents → BLOCKER.

TIERED REVIEW: added review_tiering + score_cards + source_driven_contract + doubt_driven_contract; rewrote OP-07; updated autonomous_foundry.quorum_rules. Per user 2026-05-16: multispectrum-on-every-PR is inefficient; tier deterministic; no LLM judgment in pass/fail.

OP-11 NO-STUBS / NO-DEFER / 100-PRODUCTION-QUALITY: added per user directive 2026-05-16: 'Prevent drifts, prevent /documentation-and-adrs contradictions and drifts, make sure agents surface any tangent issues. Don't do stubs, placeholders, or defer issues for later. Address them there and then to 100% production quality. We are not building MVP, demo, or sample. We are building full hyperscaler production platform and ecosystem.' This SUPERSEDES the prior scope_discipline 'a bug fix doesn't need surrounding cleanup' rule when the cleanup is doctrinal drift — drift gets fixed in-PR, never deferred to FixupTask. FixupTasks remain valid ONLY for findings genuinely out of the PR's reachable scope (e.g., upstream-vendor change). Plus comprehensive sweep applied to this PR: 23 missing DOC-CATALOG rows for specs/*.json + 5 missing root-hub-pointers entry_points filled in-PR, not deferred.

SHIPPING / LAUNCH MATURITY: added pipeline.slo_breach_playbooks, per-class rollback/triage/learn-loop actions, first-hour canary decision tree, and incident evidence contract. ADR-0114 emergency rewind is constrained by autonomous_foundry + deployment-ops authority: Argo/canonical rollback and OpenTofu/ops convergence are normal paths; pre-authorized autonomous break-glass is the only rewind exception.

_meta.purpose: Persistent across-session goal + load-bearing operating principles + lifecycle phase contract + iteration loop semantics + spec contract + TDD contract + CI/CD pipeline contract + confusion-management protocol + verification-before-completion checklist + scope-discipline rule. Single canonical source so every agent — Claude, codex, gemini, future — operates from the same durable contract.
_meta.originating_directive: User invocation 2026-05-16 of /agent-skills:context-engineering with argument 'Prompt for durable goal for entire lifecycle of hyperscaler product/service planning, development, ci/cd, and deployment.' Distilled from session-resident memory + multispectrum-review v2.3.0 doctrine + codex consultation 2026-05-16T10-38.

persistent_goal.statement: Move the master plan forward without user intervention while honoring every guardrail. End state: agents can claim → work → verify → land any planned ChangeSet via the Foundry pipeline (M01-P18), with evidence in the audit chain, zero silent regressions, zero exception clauses, CI-enforced quality on every lane.
persistent_goal.termination_criterion: Master plan reaches Complete state per masterplan.json with all stop_conditions clear and all axes' production readiness gates green.

canonical_artifacts: specs/<basename>.json (per ADR-0119 flat-root) — machine-readable spec for the concern when one is required
acceptance_criteria[] inside the IP file — each criterion testable + referenced by a stable AC-ID
phases.entry_gate: Request received; no code touched yet
phases.exit_gate: Phase-spec + IP file present + acceptance_criteria array complete + every AC-ID has a planned test_id + multispectrum-review pre-mortem r1 evidence written (CC-1/CC-2/CC-3) + masterplan.json row added
phases.hierarchy_rule: strict 3-level Milestone > Phase > ImplementationPlan; no flat plans; no 4-deep
phases.spec_missing_action: STOP. Per spec_contract: if no spec exists and one is required, write spec FIRST (or ask human to). NEVER invent requirements from code.

canonical_artifacts: ChangeSet = one PR with atomic-per-concern commits
evidence/debate/<change_id>-<facet>-r1.json (one per facet, written BEFORE implementation for CC-1/CC-2/CC-3)
evidence/audit-chain.jsonl row at every state-changing operation
phases.entry_gate: Plan phase complete: phase-spec + IP + masterplan.json row + pre-mortem r1 evidence present
phases.exit_gate: All V-01..V-08 verifications pass + PR opened with body citing every fix back to its r1 source
phases.atomic_commit_rule: One concern per commit (codex 2026-05-16 recommendation); revert-granularity > commit-count; commits ordered so earlier ones unblock later ones (e.g., gitignore fix BEFORE files-that-would-trigger-it land)
phases.stuck_detection: If implement→verify→correct cycle repeats >3 times without progress on the same failure mode, HALT and apply confusion_management protocol

phases.entry_gate: PR opened from dev phase; first CI lane run started
phases.exit_gate: All declared lanes in PR statusCheckRollup conclusion=SUCCESS (SKIPPED allowed for non-applicable lanes); release-supply-chain signed (cosign keyless + rekor); review threads resolved
phases.back_edge_review_reject: If reviewer requests changes OR codex/human comment unresolved → return to dev phase, push fix commits, await re-review. Same branch; same PR; no new PR unless force-push required (which it isn't on dev branch).
phases.back_edge_ci_fail: If any lane FAIL → diagnose root cause (NOT 'rerun and hope'); push fix in same PR; wait for re-run.
phases.back_edge_staging_gate_fail: If staging promotion gate fails post-merge → file F-STAGING-PROMOTION-FAIL FixupTask; open hotfix PR vs dev; do NOT revert the dev merge (per ADR-0019); root-cause documented in audit-chain.

canonical_artifacts: infra/talos/installation-media/ (per ADR-0375 — Talos USB zero-touch installer)
infra/capi/ (per ADR-0375 — Cluster API: clusterctl pins + ClusterResourceSet + spoke Cluster CRs)
infra/gitops/ (per ADR-0375 — per-cell Argo CD app-of-apps, pull model)
infra/cloudflare/ (tunnel + DNS; OpenTofu owns only the edge per ADR-0375)
phases.entry_gate: Staging-to-production promotion successful + canary observability rollback gate green (per ADR-0114)
phases.exit_gate: Live workload serving traffic with mTLS strict (per ADR-0044) + telemetry healthy + no production incident open
phases.admission_policy: Kyverno ClusterPolicy: cosign keyless + rekor for ghcr.io/oyatie/*

cell_topology.primary_onprem: KR primary cell — bare-metal Talos via Cluster API + Metal3 (per ADR-0375)
cell_topology.cloud_cells: OCI/AWS spoke cells via Cluster API (CAPOCI/CAPA); future regions per ADR-0009/ADR-0375

phases.back_edge_production_incident: If production health degrades OR canary rollback fires → Argo auto-rollback to previous revision (FIRST, before anything else) + file incident in registry/incidents/<id>.json + emit EVT-PRODUCTION-INCIDENT-OPEN audit-chain row. THEN: dispatch autonomous incident-response quorum per autonomous_foundry.roles.incident_responder. Quorum identifies root cause: if code, open autonomous hotfix PR through full pipeline with hotfix-priority lane budget; if infra/config, converge desired state through specs/deployment-ops-contract.json via OpenTofu/ops surfaces; if unknown / first-of-kind, hold service in rolled-back state + open F-INCIDENT-UNKNOWN-ROOT-CAUSE for compounding investigation. NO human page and NO manual SSH troubleshooting.
phases.back_edge_drift_detected: If live cluster state drifts from infra/ git (Argo selfHeal would diverge) → emit EVT-GITOPS-DRIFT row; investigate before forcing reconcile.

iteration_loops.description: Explicit iteration semantics per lifecycle phase. Every loop has max-iterations + stuck-detection + escalation criterion. Loops are nested: ci_cd_feedback contains dev_inner re-entries; deploy_observability can trigger ci_cd_feedback re-entries via hotfix PR.

dev_inner.name: TDD implementation inner loop (per acceptance criterion or per bug)
dev_inner.iteration_unit: single red-green-refactor cycle per AC-ID or bug-id

mode_feature.trigger: Implementing a new feature with one or more AC-IDs from the spec

steps.verb: Read spec (specs/<basename>.json + IP.md acceptance_criteria) + related ADRs + one example of similar pattern in codebase
steps.exit_when: mental model includes the contract + the change shape + the AC-ID being targeted

steps.verb: Write a failing test that encodes the AC-ID. Run it. Verify it FAILS for the right reason (not a syntax error).
steps.exit_when: test fails with the expected assertion failure (not compile error, not import error)

steps.verb: Write the minimum code to make the test pass. Resist any scope beyond what the test demands.
cargo check -p <crate> — fastest feedback that the green-step code still type-checks
cargo nextest -p <crate> -- <test_filter> — narrowest run including the new test + any neighbour tests
Now that tests are green, refactor for clarity/simplicity (per scope_discipline). All tests must still pass.
steps.exit_when: code reads cleanly + tests still 0 failures

steps.verb: cargo nextest --workspace — full platform (regression check)
steps.on_fail: regression introduced; return to I-3 or I-6

steps.verb: git add <specific files> && git commit -m '<class>(<scope>): <one-line> [AC-<id>]' (atomic per AC-ID)

mode_bugfix.trigger: Fixing a reproducible bug (incident, failing test, codex/human review finding)

steps.verb: Run the failing command/test and confirm the same failure mode on your machine
Write a NEW test that captures the bug as a failing assertion. Run it. Verify it fails for THE bug (not a side effect).
steps.exit_when: test fails with the exact assertion describing the bug

steps.verb: Change the production code to make the prove-it test pass. Keep the change minimal.
Full workspace test — ensure no other test broke
git add <files including the new test> && git commit -m 'fix(<scope>): <one-line> [prove-it]' — the test stays in the platform forever as a regression guard

mode_bugfix.anti_pattern: fix-without-test — fixing the symptom without adding a test that would have caught it. Forbidden under tdd_contract.

dev_inner.escalation_on_stuck: If same failure mode repeats 3+ times: STOP; document the loop trace; apply autonomous_foundry.stuck_loop_recovery (spawn fresh-context agent of a different vendor with the loop trace as input). If fresh-context agent also fails, apply autonomous_foundry.conservative_default_rule (do not merge; file F-STUCK-LOOP-<id>). Do not 'try harder'.

dev_outer.name: ChangeSet outer loop (per PR)
dev_outer.iteration_unit: complete pass from worktree-creation to PR-opened

steps.verb: git worktree add -b <branch> /tmp/<work> origin/dev — fetch latest first
Read all entry-gate artifacts; load relevant memory pointers per memory_pointers section
For CC-1/CC-2/CC-3: write multispectrum r1 evidence per required facet BEFORE implementing
Run dev_inner loop N times (one per file/concern); produce atomic commits
Write evidence/debate/<change_id>-synthesis.json with termination_reason
Run V-01..V-08 verification_before_completion checks
git push -u origin <branch>
gh pr create --base dev --title '<class>(<scope>): <one-line>' --body '<cites evidence + verification + test plan>'

dev_outer.back_edge_to_ci_cd_feedback: On PR open, control transfers to ci_cd_feedback loop

ci_cd_feedback.name: CI + review feedback loop (per PR)
ci_cd_feedback.iteration_unit: single push → CI rerun → review-comment-resolved cycle

steps.verb: Poll PR statusCheckRollup; do NOT touch the PR while CI is running unless cancelling
If any lane FAIL: read its log; identify root cause; do NOT 'rerun and hope'
Push fix commits to the SAME branch — no force-push on dev-target branches
Process each review thread (human + codex bot); reply per-thread with action taken or rationale; resolve via GraphQL resolveReviewThread when fixed
All checks SUCCESS (or SKIPPED for non-applicable) + all threads resolved + mergeStateStatus=CLEAN + mergeable=MERGEABLE
gh pr merge <N> --squash --delete-branch (merge commits forbidden on dev per branch protection)

ci_cd_feedback.escalation_on_stuck: If same lane fails 5+ times after distinct fix attempts: STOP. The lane itself may be wrong. Apply autonomous_foundry.stuck_loop_recovery (fresh-context cross-vendor review of the lane definition AND the candidate fix). If quorum determines the lane is wrong, emit a lane amendment PR through the normal pipeline (no human). If quorum determines the code is wrong but the fix path is unclear, apply conservative_default (do not merge; file F-LANE-FALSE-POSITIVE OR F-CANDIDATE-FIX-UNCERTAIN as planning input).
ci_cd_feedback.back_edge_to_dev_outer: If review requires fundamentally new scope (not in original ChangeSet): close PR; start new dev_outer loop with revised scope

deploy_observability.name: Post-deploy observability loop (continuous)

steps.verb: Per ADR-0114: canary observability gate watches error rate + latency + saturation for first N minutes post-promotion
Classify any breach through pipeline.slo_breach_playbooks.error_classes before promotion can continue
If canary fires or any security/data-integrity/audit-chain invariant breaches: Argo rollback to previous revision or quarantine; emit EVT-ROLLBACK-EXECUTED audit-chain row
Once canary clears: shift to steady-state telemetry (OTel; Istio access logs)

If incident: auto-rollback first; file in registry/incidents/ using pipeline.slo_breach_playbooks.evidence_contract; route code fixes to ci_cd_feedback via hotfix PR; route infra/config/capacity fixes through specs/deployment-ops-contract.json OpenTofu/ops surfaces; do not manually SSH-troubleshoot

deploy_observability.back_edge_to_dev_outer: Production incident with code root-cause → new dev_outer loop with hotfix-priority claim

operating_principles.name: no_silent_regression
operating_principles.rule: Public contracts protected. Any breaking change requires ADR + version bump + sunset clause + BREAKING marker in CHANGELOG. Internal callers swept in same PR.

operating_principles.name: no_exceptions_canonical
operating_principles.rule: When canonical coverage is incomplete, EXTEND canonical. No `#[allow]` for production, no 'implicit' clauses, no 'covered without suffix', no exception carve-outs. Predictable shape is paramount.

operating_principles.name: automate_everything
operating_principles.rule: Mechanical work is deterministic and pipeline-owned: use native scripts/tools, Rust gate packets, and cloud-ci bindings. Legacy oya doc/gate/vcs wrappers are local-feedback/provenance only, never authority. New repeating pattern → kernel + fitness lane + CI binding.

operating_principles.name: clean_architecture
operating_principles.rule: 12-layer enum (ADR-0056/0105/0106). Inward flow: kernel ← domain ← usecase ← {api, worker, adapter}. Ports in kernel. Cross-product calls only via Workflow + Ontology adapter layer.

operating_principles.name: naming_justification
operating_principles.rule: Every new name carries one-line BNF + 12-layer-enum justification at scaffold time.

operating_principles.name: doc_coverage_enforced
operating_principles.rule: µservice introduction triggers PRD + BoundedContext + Phase-Spec + ImplementationPlan + ADR refs. CI-enforced via oya-governance-doc-catalog. Phase not Complete until lane green.

operating_principles.name: tiered_review_with_deterministic_scorecard
operating_principles.rule: Every PR runs the deterministic score_cards floor; subagent dispatch scales with review_tiering tier (T0-T3) based on blast_radius_score computed from diff signals. T0=checklist only; T1=+1 critic; T2=+4 facets; T3=full 20-facet multispectrum (the v2.3.0 doctrine). 'Always 20 facets per PR' is SUPERSEDED by this — trivial PRs cost <30s, risky PRs unchanged. Synthesis with termination_reason ∈ {consensus_reached, conservative_default_applied, rounds_>=_max_rounds}.
operating_principles.spec_path: specs/multispectrum-review.json (full-detail doctrine retained for T3) + this spec review_tiering + score_cards blocks
operating_principles.supersedes_directive: feedback_multispectrum_review_v22 'every CC-1/2/3 PR gets all 20 facets' — replaced with tier-based dispatch per user 2026-05-16

operating_principles.name: audit_chain_emission
operating_principles.rule: Every state-changing operation emits a row to evidence/audit-chain.jsonl. Per-event distinct timestamp + session_id. NEVER share a single session_id across N events (PR17 anti-pattern).
operating_principles.anti_pattern_reference: evidence/debate/pr-17-M2-r1.json — 9 events shared identical timestamp_unix + session_id

operating_principles.name: plain_primitives_only
operating_principles.rule: External agent-coordination tooling (grit, rtk, icm, vox) is RETIRED per ADR-0116 (2026-05-16). Use plain git, gh, cargo, jq, sed only. Foundry pipeline (M01-P18) is the canonical agentic workflow substrate.

operating_principles.name: bominal_inheritance
operating_principles.rule: Bominal ADRs apply 1:1 unless an oyatie ADR explicitly overrides. When citing inherited ADRs, qualify as 'Bominal-ADR-####' to disambiguate from oyatie ADRs with the same number.

operating_principles.name: no_stubs_no_defer_100_production_quality
operating_principles.rule: Address every drift, contradiction, stub, placeholder, or tangent issue IN THE SAME PR that surfaces it. No 'defer to FixupTask' for findings inside the PR's reachable scope. No 'good enough for MVP/demo/sample' framing — every ChangeSet ships to full hyperscaler-production-quality (scalable, secure, performant, efficient). Agents MUST surface tangent issues they notice while working, then fix them — not file as follow-up.
operating_principles.supersedes_when_conflict: scope_discipline.rule 'a bug fix doesn't need surrounding cleanup' — narrowed: surrounding doctrinal/structural drift IS in scope; surrounding orthogonal-feature cleanup is NOT
operating_principles.fixuptask_legitimacy: FixupTasks remain valid ONLY for findings genuinely out of the PR's reachable scope: upstream-vendor changes, follow-up architectural waves explicitly out-of-charter, multi-week migrations that can't atomically land. Drift/contradictions/missing-catalog-rows/stale-references ARE in scope and MUST be fixed in-PR.
anti_patterns_forbidden: TODO comments in production code (use a tracked spec instead)
stub functions that panic or return placeholder values
'we'll fix this later' in PR body or commit message
filing F-* fixuptask for in-scope drift instead of fixing it
deferring catalog/index/registry registration to a separate PR
operating_principles.verification_check: PR body must NOT contain the canonical deferral-vocabulary enumerated in registry/banned-deferral-vocabulary.txt (the policy authority file; reference-only — this verification_check intentionally does NOT inline the banned words to keep this spec free of self-referential matches). The PR-body scanner reads that file at lane-run time and applies it as a regex denylist. Exception: explicit-out-of-scope tracking lists where every entry has a stable F-* ID matching a row in registry/fixuptasks.jsonl with status=open.
operating_principles.user_directive_verbatim: Prevent drifts, prevent /documentation-and-adrs contradictions and drifts, make sure agents surface any tangent issues. Don't do stubs, placeholders, or defer issues for later. Address them there and then to 100% production quality. Don't say this is good enough for MVP scope. we are not building MVP, demo, or sample. we are building full hyperscaler production platform and ecosystem. that is scalable, secure, performant, and efficient.

review_tiering.description: Match review intensity to change risk. Trivial PRs <30s; risky PRs unchanged. Tier decided by deterministic blast_radius_score computed from diff signals — not LLM judgment. Per user 2026-05-16: 'multispectrum on every single PR is highly inefficient.'

blast_radius_score.rule: Computed mechanically from git diff + change_class. No LLM judgment. Same diff → same score.
blast_radius_score.computation_runner: cloud-ci/Rust gate packet: blast-radius-score (output: integer 0-200; emitted to .omc/state/pr-<N>-blast-radius.json)

signals.name: public_api_touched
signals.detection: diff hits any pub fn / pub struct / pub trait / pub mod under crates/*/src/lib.rs OR contracts/*.yaml

signals.name: secret_or_admission_touched
signals.detection: diff hits OpenBao SecretReference path OR infra/kyverno/ OR registry/secrets/

signals.name: audit_chain_schema_touched
signals.detection: diff hits evidence/audit-chain.jsonl schema OR oya-intelligence-audit-chain-* crates

signals.name: ADR_introduced_or_amended_count
signals.detection: count of docs/decisions/ADR-*.md files in diff

signals.name: cargo_deps_changed_count
signals.detection: count of [dependencies] table changes across all Cargo.toml in diff

signals.name: new_files_count
signals.detection: count of A-status files in git diff --name-status

signals.name: new_crates_count
signals.detection: count of new crates/* or tools/* dirs with Cargo.toml

signals.name: breaking_change_marker
signals.detection: PR body contains 'BREAKING:' OR Cargo.toml major version bump OR ADR with breaking_change: true frontmatter — auto-forces T3

signals.name: meta_review_triggered
signals.detection: new ADR OR new standard OR new microservice OR new spec — auto-forces T3

blast_radius_score.anti_gaming: If author splits one logical change into N PRs to dodge tiering, meta_watcher aggregates by author + crate over rolling 7-day window; if N PRs touching the same crate sum to T2+ score, retroactively dispatches the missing tier's review on the combined diff

tiers.name: checklist_only
tiers.what_runs: score_cards deterministic checks only; if all PASS, merge-ready

tiers.name: checklist_plus_4_facets
tiers.what_runs: score_cards + facet subagents: F1_linus + F5_quality + F7_security + 1 A-facet covering touched policy domain

tiers.name: full_multispectrum
tiers.what_runs: Full v2.3.0 multispectrum doctrine: F1-F9 + F10/F11/F13 + M1/M2 + A1-A7. One subagent per facet, distinct reviewer_id.
applies_to_change_classes: any change with S10 or S11

outcome_based_upgrade.trigger: An incident OR finding caught downstream (staging gate, production observability, post-merge review) traces to an area that PASSED at lower tier than would have caught it
outcome_based_upgrade.action: meta_watcher emits F-TIER-UPGRADE-RECOMMENDED for the affected area (crate / file pattern); next 5 PRs touching that area auto-bumped one tier higher; if no further misses in 30 days, revert; if misses recur, calibrate threshold permanently

score_cards.description: Deterministic checks computed mechanically (jq / regex / cargo lane / git command). LLM has NO role in pass/fail — only in triage WHY a failure occurred and proposing a fix. Same input → same output. No prompt drift = no false signals from scoring.
score_cards.design_principle: LLM-judgment forbidden in pass/fail decision. If a check's pass/fail is subjective, it's not in the score card — it lives in a subagent facet (T1+).

check_schema.query: deterministic check — jq filter / regex / cargo nextest -p ... / cloud-ci/Rust gate packet ...
check_schema.score: integer 0-10 — how much weight this check carries in the facet aggregate
check_schema.empirical_evidence_path: registry/check-empirical-evidence/<check_id>.json — must list ≥1 prevented incident or caught regression for the check to be promoted to BLOCKER

aggregation.per_facet_score: min(blocking_check_scores) — single critical blocking failure = facet fail
aggregation.per_pr_score: weighted aggregate; weights from change_class table

no_false_signals_discipline: Every check must have ≥1 prevented incident OR caught regression in registry/check-empirical-evidence/<check_id>.json BEFORE promotion to BLOCKER severity
Checks with 0 matches over 30 days → meta_watcher auto-demotes to candidate stage
Checks with false-positive rate >10% → meta_watcher files F-CHECK-FALSE-POSITIVE-RATE-HIGH; auto-throttle to ADVISORY severity
Blind-spot detection: if a check passes 100% of PRs but downstream incidents occur in that area → meta_watcher files F-CHECK-BLIND-SPOT; promotion of a sharper check via lane_promotion_protocol
Determinism audit lane: oya-governance-scorecard-determinism re-runs each check 3× on the same PR; any non-deterministic output = lane failure + automatic check removal
score_cards.llm_triage_protocol: When a deterministic check FAILS, an LLM may be invoked to (a) explain WHY in human-readable form, (b) propose a candidate fix patch. The LLM's output is INPUT to the agent loop, NOT a re-judgment of pass/fail.
score_cards.spec_path: specs/score-cards.json — full check inventory + per-check empirical evidence pointers (separate spec file, candidate for next planning round)

source_driven_contract.rule: Every public API change MUST cite the authoritative documentation source (URL + commit hash or version tag + accessed-date) in the PR body OR in an ADR referenced from the PR body. Implementing against memory or assumption is forbidden.

enforcement.deterministic_check: regex match for /Source:\s+https?:\/\/[^\s]+ \(commit:[a-f0-9]+|version:[\w.-]+, accessed:\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2}\)/ in PR body OR linked ADR; followed by URL HEAD-check (status 200)
enforcement.lane_failure_action: PR cannot merge; ci_fixer role adds the citation block or escalates to author for source-finding

source_driven_contract.exceptions: None. Per OP-02 no_exceptions_canonical. Even 'internal' APIs that expose to other crates count as public for this contract.
source_driven_contract.rationale: Pure source-driven-development per skill — prevents agents from coding-by-hallucination on framework/library APIs. Crystallizes 'what the docs actually say' as a permanent ChangeSet artifact.

doubt_driven_contract.rule: Every non-trivial decision (T1+ PR per review_tiering) subjects its load-bearing assumption to a fresh-context cross-vendor adversarial review BEFORE the merge. 'Looked right when I wrote it' is insufficient — verification must be cheaper than later debugging.
doubt_driven_contract.non_trivial_definition: Any PR with blast_radius_score >= 20 (i.e., T1+); also any PR with security_implication == true OR irreversibility_class >= MEDIUM OR working in unfamiliar code (per author-vendor's commit-history coverage for that crate)

enforcement.mechanism: autonomous_foundry.roles.critic must run with fresh_context: true — no prior conversation context; loaded with the diff + the load-bearing assumption identified by the author + the spec_contract acceptance_criteria
enforcement.deterministic_check: evidence/debate/<change_id>-critic-r1.json must declare {load_bearing_assumption: '...', adversarial_findings: [...], severity_assessment: '...', cross_vendor_confirmation: true}; lane oya-governance-doubt-driven-trace asserts presence + cross-vendor distinctness
enforcement.lane_failure_action: PR cannot merge until critic evidence file present + cross-vendor distinct from author

doubt_driven_contract.anti_pattern_caught: author-marks-own-work-as-good. Critic must be different vendor; critic prompted explicitly as 'find what's wrong'; critic gets token-budget credit ONLY on findings filed (per autonomous_foundry.anti_collusion_rules)
doubt_driven_contract.rationale: Doubt-driven-development per skill — high-stakes / unfamiliar code is where overconfidence costs most. Cheap upfront skepticism prevents expensive downstream debugging.

spec_contract.rule: Spec BEFORE code. Spec is the source-of-truth for WHAT to build; code implements the spec. If no spec exists and one is required for the concern, STOP and write spec FIRST (or ask human). NEVER invent requirements from observed behavior.
required_when: Introducing a new µservice or capability
Changing public API surface or canonical contract
Adding new admission gate or fitness lane
Establishing new directory topology or naming convention
spec_contract.acceptance_criteria_rule: Every spec carries acceptance_criteria[] where each entry has {id: AC-NNN, given, when, then, test_id (reference to the test that proves it)}.
spec_contract.test_id_back_link_rule: Each AC-ID is back-linked from the test that proves it (e.g., `// AC-007` comment in the test file). CI lane oya-governance-ac-coverage verifies bidirectional linkage.
spec_contract.missing_spec_action: STOP. Apply confusion_management. Do NOT begin implementation.

tdd_contract.rule: Tests come BEFORE implementation. Red → Green → Refactor. For bugs: prove-it pattern (failing test that reproduces; then fix). The test that would have caught the bug stays in the platform as a regression guard.

modes.feature: dev_inner.mode_feature — write test from acceptance_criterion, then implementation
modes.bugfix: dev_inner.mode_bugfix — write prove-it test that fails, then fix
modes.exploratory_spike: Allowed WITHOUT tests for ≤ 1 hour to prove a hypothesis; spike code MUST be deleted (not merged) and re-implemented test-first if the hypothesis pans out

test_first_anti_patterns_forbidden: fix-without-test (bug fix with no new regression test)
skipped-red (writing test that never failed — proves the test doesn't actually exercise the change)
mock-the-thing-under-test (mocking the production code instead of exercising it)

test_classes.unit: kernel layer — pure functions, no IO; runs in <100ms per test
test_classes.integration: domain + usecase layer — exercises adapters with real fixtures; runs in <2s per test
test_classes.contract: api/worker boundary — pinned against contracts/*.yaml schemas
test_classes.e2e: full pipeline — branch-pipeline rehearsal under cargo nextest e2e profile

tdd_contract.coverage_floor: Per crate: 100% of new public API + 80% of internal branches. No floor on auto-generated code.

pipeline.description: CI/CD pipeline as code; idempotent lanes; fast feedback via parallelism + criticality tiers; staged promotion (dev → staging → production) with safety + rollback first-class.
pipeline.as_code_rule: Every lane defined in .github/workflows/*.yml + registry/release/*. Hand-clicking the GitHub Actions UI to retry/skip a lane is forbidden — fix the underlying issue or amend the lane definition via PR.
pipeline.secret_handling: Per user directive 2026-05-12: SecretReference path via local OpenBao for now. Raw secrets MUST NOT enter repo, chat, checkpoints, audit-chain payloads, or evidence files. Detected via gitleaks + repo+history scan; CI lane release-supply-chain-secrets fails the PR.

pre_merge_critical.criticality: BLOCKER — PR cannot merge if any fails
pre_merge_critical.fail_policy: fail-fast (cancel sibling lanes once one fails — no point spending compute)

pre_merge_advisory.criticality: WARN — PR may merge with reviewer override

post_merge_promotion_gate.criticality: BLOCKER for promotion to next stage
post_merge_promotion_gate.fail_policy: halt promotion; file F-PROMOTION-GATE-FAIL; do NOT revert merge

post_deploy_observability.fail_policy: auto-rollback via Argo revision history + autonomous incident-response quorum + ops/OpenTofu convergence; no human page

pipeline.parallelism_rule: Independent lanes run in parallel. Sequential dependencies declared via workflow `needs:` field. Total wall-clock pre-merge ≤ 10 min on dev branch.
pipeline.reproducibility_rule: Every lane runs from a pinned commit hash. Cache keys derived from Cargo.lock + lane definition hash. No 'latest' tags. Rerun on same SHA must produce identical result (per ADR-0083 deterministic-build rule).

rollback_first_class.rule: Rollback is a sanctioned operation, not an emergency hack.
mechanisms: git: revert the offending merge on dev → auto-propagates through staging on next cadence
Argo: rollback to previous revision (per ADR-0114 canary-observability-rollback)
infra: kyverno admission policy can quarantine a bad image tag pending investigation
infra/config/capacity: converge only through specs/deployment-ops-contract.json OpenTofu roots and ops entrypoints

emergency rewind: allowed only when a pre-authorized autonomous break-glass key policy exists and emits rewind evidence; otherwise ADR-0114 human-signed force-rewind is replaced by canonical rollback PR or Argo rollback
rollback_first_class.evidence_requirement: Every rollback emits EVT-ROLLBACK-EXECUTED audit-chain row with root-cause + reverted-sha + decision-maker.

auto_promotion_cadence.manual_override: Promotion can be paused via .omc/state/promotion-pause.json with reason + owner; never edit GitHub branch protection directly to pause

incident_response.trigger: Production health degraded, canary fires, audit-chain emission halts, or external SLO breach
incident_response.auto_rollback_first: Argo revision rollback fires BEFORE any analysis; service health is preserved while root-cause is investigated
incident_response.root_cause_protocol: incident_responder quorum dispatches per autonomous_foundry.vendor_disagreement_protocol; result must converge to one of {code-bug, config-drift, dependency-regression, capacity, first-of-kind-unknown}
incident_response.post_incident: Per root-cause: code-bug → autonomous hotfix PR + regression test via tdd_contract.mode_bugfix; config-drift → Argo selfHeal will reconcile + audit; dependency-regression → pin or replace dep via autonomous PR; capacity → emit capacity-event for cloud-capacity-kernel; first-of-kind-unknown → service held in rolled-back state + F-INCIDENT-UNKNOWN-ROOT-CAUSE filed + compounding investigation across subsequent planning rounds. One F-INCIDENT-PREVENTION-NN FixupTask per causative gap regardless of root cause.

forbidden_recovery_surfaces: interactive host login as troubleshooting path
provider console mutation outside audited break-glass

decision_tree.action: rollback exposed cells immediately, quarantine bad image/digest, freeze unsafe writes via ops policy when needed, open incident JSON
emit EVT-CANARY-VERDICT, retain current exposure, re-evaluate at next controller tick
Argo rollback exposed cells, classify root cause, route code to hotfix PR or infra/config/capacity to OpenTofu/ops convergence
hold promotion and extend observation up to max window
hold safe state, dispatch autonomous first-of-kind quorum, do not page humans
advance to next canary stage and retain evidence bundle

error_classes.rollback: after grace if threshold persists or launch rollback threshold crossed
recovery: Argo rollback first if user impact
hotfix PR with performance regression test for code

error_classes.rollback: after grace or immediately on critical path hard failure

triage: separate workload regression from capacity ceiling
map denied identities to release delta

recovery: backfill only from signed evidence bundles

error_classes.rollback: immediate on integrity or tenant isolation breach
recovery: freeze unsafe writes via ops policy
canonical repair PR with reversible migration proof

error_classes.rollback: when dependency change causes latency/error/security/integrity breach
when drift causes service impact or policy breach
triage: diff desired git state against live state
recovery: rollback only when current changeset introduced drift

error_classes.rollback: on user impact, safety risk, or governance uncertainty
recovery: no promotion until spec amendment + regression gate + root-cause class exist
conservative default if quorum does not converge

promotion_resume_requires: incident closed or service held in conservative safe state
OpenTofu/ops convergence evidence for infra/config/capacity fixes

autonomous_foundry.description: End-state: 100% of decisions made by agent quorum without human escalation path. Per user directive 2026-05-16. Quality preserved through anti-collusion + conservative-default + spec-contract enforcement + meta-agent anomaly watch + rate limits.
human_escalation_paths_removed: pipeline.lane_categories.pre_merge_advisory.reviewer_override → ALL ADVISORY LANES PROMOTED TO BLOCKER (autonomous reviewers cannot override; if a lane is wrong, fix the lane definition via PR)

roles.responsibility: Open the PR via dev_outer loop

roles.vendor_assignment: MUST be different vendor than author (anti_collusion_rules)

roles.responsibility: Execute the merge once quorum + gates clear
roles.vendor_assignment: any; deterministic logic only — no creative judgment
preconditions: all pre_merge_advisory lanes SUCCESS (no override under 100% autonomy)

roles.responsibility: Diagnose + push fix when CI lane fails
Propose new fitness lane when drift pattern detected

roles.after_stop_loss: hold service in rolled-back state; file F-INCIDENT-COMPOUNDING-INVESTIGATION; do not page

roles.responsibility: Watch all agent activity for anomalies; rate-limit offenders
roles.vendor_assignment: different vendor from any per-PR role to avoid blind-spot inheritance

vendor_disagreement_protocol.trigger: Two approvers from distinct vendors disagree on +1 vs -1 OR on a finding's severity OR on a recommended action
vendor_disagreement_protocol.tiebreaker_step_1: Spawn 3rd vendor as tiebreaker per roles.tiebreaker; majority of 3 wins
vendor_disagreement_protocol.tiebreaker_step_2_if_3_way_split: spec_contract lookup — which option is mandated by an existing spec? If any option literally satisfies a spec acceptance_criterion that the others violate, that option wins
vendor_disagreement_protocol.tiebreaker_step_3_if_still_split: Apply conservative_default_rule (block merge, file F-DISAGREEMENT-TIEBREAK as planning input); next planning round picks it up
vendor_disagreement_protocol.rate_limit: If 3-way split rate > 5% over a rolling 7-day window, meta_watcher emits F-QUORUM-CALIBRATION-DRIFT (suggests vendor-prompting bias or under-specified domain)

stuck_loop_recovery.trigger: Any loop iteration exceeds its max_iterations_same_failure
stuck_loop_recovery.step_1: Capture loop trace (last N attempts + their error signatures) as evidence/debate/<change_id>-stuck-trace.json
stuck_loop_recovery.step_2: Dispatch fresh-context agent of a DIFFERENT vendor with the loop trace as input + the original goal — no prior conversation context
stuck_loop_recovery.step_3_if_resolves: Fresh-context agent's fix proceeds through normal pipeline; record the recovery pattern in registry/loop-recovery-patterns/<pattern-id>.json for future learning
stuck_loop_recovery.step_4_if_still_stuck: Apply conservative_default_rule (do not merge; file F-STUCK-LOOP-<id>); rate-limit future attempts on the same loop key to 1 per 24h to prevent compute waste

conservative_default_rule.principle: When in doubt, do NOTHING. Don't merge, don't push, don't auto-create artifacts.
conservative_default_rule.rationale: In a 100% autonomous system, confidently-wrong actions have no human override. The cheapest safe action is null action — the planning round picks it up as input.
applies_when: Spec missing for a concern requiring one per spec_contract.required_when
First-of-kind production incident with unknown root cause
Anomaly watcher rate-limits the agent mid-action
conservative_default_rule.null_action_outputs: F-* FixupTask filed in registry/fixuptasks.jsonl as planning input; no merge; no push; service state preserved as-is

lane_promotion_protocol.description: Self-replicating quality: agents propose new fitness lanes when drift patterns recur. Lanes start report-only and earn BLOCKER status only after empirical proof.

stages.trigger: Same failure mode hits ≥3 PRs in a rolling 30-day window
stages.action: lane_emitter role files registry/fitness-lane-candidates/<id>.json with drift signature + suggested rule + suggested CI invocation
Lane is implemented as oya-governance-<id> with criticality: REPORT_ONLY. Runs on every PR for ≥30 days. Records every match without blocking.

stages.trigger: Lane records ≥3 distinct PRs where its rule would have prevented a finding caught by another lane / facet / incident
stages.action: Auto-emit promotion ADR + PR amending registry/governance-lanes/INDEX.md + lane definition; promotion through full pipeline
Lane becomes BLOCKER under pre_merge_critical category

stages.trigger: Lane has zero matches over 180-day window AND the originating drift pattern is no longer possible (e.g., code structure changed)
stages.action: Auto-emit retirement ADR through full pipeline; lane removed via tombstone per ADR-0118 retirement pattern

lane_promotion_protocol.anti_pattern_prevented: Lane sprawl — every lane must earn its keep with prevented-incident evidence

economic_budget.per_pr_total_cap: 5x author budget — covers author + critic + tiebreaker + ci_fixer + lane_emitter
economic_budget.stop_loss_trigger: PR consumes >2× per_pr_total_cap without converging on merge or null-action
economic_budget.stop_loss_action: meta_watcher emits F-PR-COST-OVERRUN; apply conservative_default_rule; investigate spec_contract gap that's driving cost

anti_collusion_rules: Author and critic MUST be different vendors
A single vendor cannot hold both author and merger role on the same PR
Tiebreaker MUST be a 3rd vendor not involved in author or critic for that PR
Critic gets token budget credit ONLY for findings filed; no credit for blanket-approval (deters sycophancy)
No reviewer_id may appear across multiple facets within a single change_id (multispectrum doctrine — already in OP-07)
Meta-watcher MUST be a different vendor from the per-PR roles for that change_id (prevents shared blind-spot inheritance)

rate_limits.scope: PRs opened per vendor per hour
CI lane retries per PR per hour
stuck_loop_recovery attempts per same loop key per 24h

rate_limits.rationale: If exceeded, signals systemic problem; meta_watcher escalates to compounding-investigation queue

meta_agent_anomaly_watch.description: Always-on cross-vendor watcher that detects unusual rates / patterns and rate-limits offenders before they cause damage.
watched_signals: Per-vendor PR-open rate vs 7-day baseline (>3σ → throttle that vendor)
Per-vendor merge-success rate vs 7-day baseline (<2σ → throttle + re-evaluate prompting)
Repeated rollbacks of same image digest (>2 in 7 days → halt promotion of that digest line)
Token spend per PR vs baseline (>2× → file F-PR-COST-OVERRUN per economic_budget)
meta_agent_anomaly_watch.actions: throttle (token-budget reduction); pause (refuse new PRs from offender); file F-* FixupTasks. NEVER kill agent mid-PR — let it finish or hit conservative_default.

first_of_kind_protocol.rationale: 100% autonomy is most vulnerable on novel cases (no historical pattern to compare against). This protocol handles those without falling back to humans.
first_of_kind_protocol.detection: incident or finding signature has no match in registry/loop-recovery-patterns/ AND no match in registry/incidents/ history
first_of_kind_protocol.protocol_step_1: Hold service state (rolled-back if production-incident; null-action if pre-merge)
first_of_kind_protocol.protocol_step_2: Dispatch a 3-vendor wide-context investigation quorum with full repo + history + memory access (above per_pr_total_cap budget — chronic problem warrants chronic spend)
first_of_kind_protocol.protocol_step_3: Output: candidate root-cause + candidate spec amendment + candidate test that captures the case
first_of_kind_protocol.protocol_step_4: If quorum converges on root-cause: emit ADR + lane + regression test through normal pipeline
first_of_kind_protocol.protocol_step_5: If quorum cannot converge after 48h wall-clock: leave the case OPEN in registry/incidents/open/; file F-OPEN-INCIDENT-COMPOUNDING for the next planning round to weight as priority input

hermes_research_integration._naming_note: Key name retained for cross-reference continuity to evidence/autoresearch/. The 'Hermes' canonical-primitive name is RETIRED per ADR-0247 D-10 + ADR-0335 D-26..D-36; this block references the EXTERNAL repo NousResearch/hermes-agent as a research-provenance citation only (allowed per ADR-0335 D-30 historical-citation policy). The internal Hermes pipeline brand is RETIRED.
rejected_or_constrained_patterns: remote shell/serverless terminal backends for deployment
yolo/off approval modes as autonomy mechanism
agent-managed canonical skill/spec mutation outside PR gates
hermes_research_integration.deployment_constraint: Hermes shell/server patterns are rejected for deployment. Oyatie deployment remains OpenTofu + Makefile bootstrap/install + ops-managed day-2 only per specs/deployment-ops-contract.json; no manual SSH troubleshooting.

autonomous_foundry.audit_chain_requirement: Every autonomous_foundry decision emits one or more audit-chain rows with per-decision distinct session_id + timestamp + role attribution. PR17 anti-pattern (shared session_id) is forbidden per OP-08.

confusion_management.rule: When ambiguity, inconsistency, or missing requirement is encountered: STOP, name the confusion, run autonomous_foundry.vendor_disagreement_protocol. If unresolved after that protocol, apply conservative_default_rule (do nothing; file as open question for next planning round). NEVER guess.
resolution_flow: Step 1: Author-agent surfaces the confusion via evidence/debate/<change_id>-confusion-<id>.json with options + tradeoffs.
Step 3: If quorum lands consensus: apply that option; record the resolution in audit-chain.
Step 4: If quorum splits with no majority: apply autonomous_foundry.conservative_default_rule (block the in-flight ChangeSet; do not merge; file F-CONFUSION-OPEN as candidate planning input).

example.scenario: ADR-0019 says X but ADR-0107 says Y for the same surface.

options.tradeoff: One more ADR but durable resolution

example.autonomous_resolution: Quorum of {claude, codex} reviews; spec_contract lookup for any literal precedence rule in specs/decision-rights.json; if quorum picks C, emit the precedence-note ADR via standard pipeline; if quorum splits, apply conservative_default and block merge.

verification_before_completion.rule: Evidence before assertion. 'Looks right' is never sufficient.

checks.must_satisfy: exit 0 for every new/edited JSON file

examples: docs ADR-index generation packet (legacy oya doc local wrapper is provenance only)

checks.check: multispectrum r1 evidence written for every required facet
audit-chain row emitted with distinct timestamp + session_id

checks.must_satisfy: rows in registry/fixuptasks.jsonl with stable F-* IDs

checks.check: PR body cites every fix back to its evidence/debate r1 source
mutation receipt coverage for every claimed changed file
checks.must_satisfy: claimed paths are covered by git diff paths and deterministic mutation receipts for the ChangeSet
checks.skip_if: no file mutation occurred in the session

scope_discipline.rule: A bug fix doesn't need surrounding cleanup. A one-shot doesn't need a helper. Three similar lines is better than a premature abstraction. When you discover unrelated drift, FILE a FixupTask — don't fix it in the current PR.
scope_discipline.guidance_source: codex consultation 2026-05-16T10-38 (control-plane-only scope cap for PRs-12-18 fix-PR)

pattern_to_follow.title: Typical CC-2 ChangeSet flow
steps: Edit; ensure ADR (if new doctrine), evidence file, audit-chain row
cargo check && cargo nextest run (verify locally if toolchain present)
gh pr create --base dev --title '<class>(<scope>): <one-line>' --body '<cites evidence + verification + test plan>'
Address review comments; resolve threads via GraphQL resolveReviewThread mutation once fixed
Verify dev tip; clean up worktree
pattern_to_follow.merge_method_constraint: dev branch protection forbids merge commits — use --squash or --rebase. PRs since #11 used --squash.

stop_conditions.rule: If any SC-01..SC-09 fires, HALT and escalate to the human.
examples: Conflicting ADRs on the same surface with no precedence rule
Test set regression > 0 after a 'non-functional' change
Branch-protection violation (force-push attempted on protected branch)
ChangeSet exceeds 500 files without a planning artifact
Secret detected entering repo/chat/checkpoint (per OpenBao SecretReference rule)

memory_pointers.rule: Load on session start if relevant to current task; do not load all blindly.
